findings.finding: Bahnhof is subject to an unconditional mandatory cash offer of SEK 62 per share from Telenor Sverige, open until 7 December, recommended by the independent committee, with Telenor already holding ~66.9% of capital and 90.6% of votes; the stock (61.8 at seal, 61.8-62.0 since 6 Nov) is pinned under that ceiling, so the Q3 print is noise and the only room is the 0.32% gross spread to the offer.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the offer went unconditional the daily closes are 62.0, 62.0, 62.0, 62.0, 61.8, 61.8, 61.8 (6-16 Nov); the only non-zero day was -0.32%. Approval day (3 Nov) moved +3.18% as the deal risk resolved.
findings.original_quote: Den oberoende kommittén i styrelsen för Bahnhof AB (publ) rekommenderar enhälligt att bolagets aktieägare ska acceptera budpliktsbudet om 62 kronor kontant per aktie från Telenor Sverige AB. (The independent committee of Bahnhof's board unanimously recommends shareholders accept the mandatory offer of SEK 62 cash per share from Telenor Sverige AB.) Also: 'En oberoende kommitté ... kommer att lämna sin uppfattning om budet senast två veckor före utgången av acceptfristen den 7 december.' (Nyhetsbyrån Direkt, 2026-11-06)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the spot sits 0.32% under the offer and realised daily moves since 6 Nov are 0 or -0.32%. The finding is the reason the move should be tiny, not a mispricing; if the market had NOT priced it the stock would trade far from 62 on report day. The small positive sign is only time-decay of the spread as settlement nears and the ceiling makes the distribution skewed toward the offer.
